MSME Day: Group Urges National Quality Mission for Global Integration

On International MSME Day, the International Federation of Quality Management (IFQM) has called for the establishment of a National Quality Mission. This initiative aims to integrate India's Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) into global value chains. The proposal highlights the importance of quality standards for enhancing the competitiveness of Indian MSMEs on the international stage.
